name: Downtown Dubai
description: A modern and luxurious district known for the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and upscale residential towers with stunning skyline views.

name: Manhattan
description: The heart of New York City, home to Central Park, Wall Street, Times Square, and some of the world’s most iconic skyscrapers.

name: Shibuya
description: A bustling commercial and nightlife center famous for its scramble crossing, shopping, entertainment, and vibrant city life.

name: Montmartre
description: A charming hilltop neighborhood known for its artistic history, cobblestone streets, and the stunning Basilica of Sacré-Cœur.

name: Zamalek
description: An affluent island district on the Nile featuring embassies, cultural venues, and a mix of elegant old villas and modern apartments.

name: Bondi Beach
description: A world-famous coastal area offering golden sand beaches, surf culture, seaside cafés, and a laid-back Australian lifestyle.
